label: Tax refund: minimum spend per transaction
unit: KRW in a single qualifying purchase
appliesTo: Eligible non-resident shoppers at licensed tax refund merchants in Korea
why: The threshold applies to one transaction at one merchant, which is the part people misread — two purchases below it at different shops do not combine into one above it. It is also the figure most often quoted from an out-of-date guide, and the whole refund turns on it: below the line no refund record is created at all, and nothing can be recovered at the airport afterwards.

history.source: Korea Tourism Organization — tax refund guidance
history.note: Per single qualifying purchase at a licensed refund merchant. Applies to immediate, downtown and airport refunds alike. Purchases at different merchants are not aggregated to reach it.
